units: Targ. Job XXXVII, 9 עִילָא.—ע׳ מן, לע׳ מן above, over. [Dan. VI, 3 עֵלָּא.] Targ. Y. Gen. I, 7.
Targ. Num. I, 3 (O. ed. Vien. לעֵלָּא); a. v. fr.—מִלְּעֵ׳ from on high, above.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 50:4">Targ. Ps. L, 4</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum of I Chronicles 11:11">Targ. I Chr. XI, 11</cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Bava Batra 45a:4">B. Bath. 45ᵃ</cite> <he>דסלקין לע׳ ודנחתין לתתא</he> (for) those who go up (to Palestine) and those who come down (to Babylonia). Y. ib. VI, end, 15ᶜ <he>חדא מלע׳ וכ׳</he> one (grave) above and one below.

<cite ref="Shabbat 30a:6">Sabb. 30ᵃ</cite> <he>שאול … לע׳ מר׳ תנחום</he> they asked this question over (the head of) R. Tanḥum, i.e. those standing by him when he was teaching (v. <cite ref="A02003"><he>אֲמוֹרָא</he></cite>).
Ḥull. 51ᵃ לע׳ מרבי רבה with the great Rabbi when he was teaching; a. fr.—עִילוֹי upon him.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 28:13">Targ. Y. Gen. XXVIII, 13</cite>; a. e.—Y. Ber. II, 4ᶜ bot. <he>כד הויין תפילוי ע׳</he> when he had his T’fillin on.

<cite ref="Yoma 2a">Ib.</cite> <he>ולא סמכין ע׳</he> but we do not rely upon him, a. e.—[Usu. <cite ref="P00572"><he>עִילַוֵּיה</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="P00572"><he>עִילָוֵי</he></cite>, or <cite ref="P00780"><he>עֲלוֹי</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="P00757"><he>עַל</he></cite> ch.]
